title: Drishta-AI
subtitle: AI-powered Digital Safety Platform (Hackathon Winner)
description: An AI platform built to protect online dignity and verify media truth. It uses machine learning to detect deepfakes in uploaded images, checks if social media links are safe or high-risk, and automatically generates ready-to-file cybersecurity complaints to report harassment.

title: GMS Crunch Experience
subtitle: Gourmet Snack E-Commerce Web Store
description: A modern online store built for an Indian snack brand. Customers can browse delicious flavors (like Classic Masala and Nimbu Mirchi), manage their shopping cart, watch real snackers' review videos, and securely purchase products through a smooth checkout flow.

title: MyVoice.ai
subtitle: AI-Powered Civic Accountability Portal
description: A civic-tech platform that connects citizens with municipal workers to fix local issues. Citizens submit photos of potholes or broken streetlights, an AI department sorter assigns it to field teams, and GPS mapping prevents double submissions while awarding points to active users.

title: AI Reflex Arena
subtitle: Reaction Time Game & Performance Dashboard
description: A web application that tests and records human reflex speeds in real-time. It gathers gameplay reaction statistics and represents your performance over time in clean, interactive charts to track speed improvements.

title: My Portfolio
subtitle: Interactive Resume & Content Console
description: My personal developer website featuring a 3D responsive digital ID card that tilts in response to your cursor. Includes a secure password-protected control panel to edit text, upload certificates, and manage project details directly.

title: Palamner Palace
subtitle: Heritage Tourism Showcase Site
description: An interactive tour and presentation site created for a historic palace resort. It showcases heritage details, tourist packages, and property layouts in a clean and welcoming visual design.

title: Play Store Analytics
subtitle: App Store Market Sentiment Pipeline
description: A data analysis project that evaluates thousands of Google Play Store applications. It uncovers app market trends and predicts what makes an app successful by evaluating ratings, installation size, downloads, and user reviews.

title: MERN Mastery
subtitle: Full-Stack Web Starter Templates
description: A developer collection repository containing pre-built templates, secure logins, and database schemas. It acts as a quick-start toolkit to build full-stack web applications quickly.

title: MERN Stack Core
subtitle: Backend API Blueprints & Security
description: A backend blueprint showcasing secure connection routes, file upload handles, server settings, and access control headers to connect React clients to databases safely.

title: Result Prediction Hub
subtitle: Academic Performance Estimator
description: An academic interface modeling student grades. It visualizes performance indicators, GPA predictions, and school metrics to track student progress throughout the semester.

title: Battleship Game
subtitle: Classic Naval Combat Browser Game
description: A web-based version of the classic Battleship naval combat game. Play matches against an automated computer opponent that takes smart tactical shots across the grid.
